mechanism: Pantoprazole may reduce gastric pH-dependent absorption of piperacillin-tazobactam, though clinical significance is minimal as beta-lactams are not highly pH-dependent; potential for increased seizure risk in susceptible patients receiving high-dose piperacillin.
action: No dose adjustment required; monitor for seizure activity in patients with renal impairment receiving high piperacillin doses; combination is generally safe for empiric therapy.
